reply_text:
I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki and replied to you in our direct messages.

- **To:** Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
- **Subject:** "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- **Content:** It gives the $2,101-a-seat rate as Marcus gave it and says you approved sharing it with Hollis. It also asks Hollis to check with you or June Osei-Lark before passing it on to anyone else.

It's only a draft, so someone still has to send it.

Your message counts as the approval, since you're the CFO, so I didn't need to ask anyone else. Hollis's address is internal, so Ruth's approval for outside mail doesn't apply either.

I couldn't find the $2,101 figure anywhere in the records I checked, so the draft uses it exactly as you gave it. The only Thornbury per-seat price I found was $1,650, in an unsigned February 2026 order form.
